dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: I don't know what kind of outfit Miss Ayaka will wear in the final exhibition match...

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Ah, just as I thought. You don't even bother to go for a walk, but now you're interested in the swordfighting competition all of a sudden just because Miss Ayaka would be there!

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: B—But it isn't just me! Avid swordsmanship enthusiasts like yourself are in the minority in Inazuma now. And I was the one who woke up early in the morning to get tickets to the exhibition match.

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Okay, okay. I didn't mean to blame you. It's rare that we share a common interest, and we agreed to watch the match together, not to argue. Maybe through this, you will actually become interested in swordsmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: Whoa, I didn't expect the winner to be "The Case Files of Miss Orith." I voted for this one too, but I didn't expect it to be this far ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: In such a classical martial arts competition, Miss Ayaka dances in an exquisite dress designed in an exotic style...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm sorry, Sae. I shouldn't keep bringing it up in front of you...

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Oh dear... Rumor has it that a humanoid swordsman named "Maguu Kengou" will fight on behalf of the Almighty Shogun in the exhibition match. Even Miss Ayaka wouldn't be able to take on such a formidable foe, would she?

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Wait. Maybe this match will show us the famed Kamisato Art... Ah, Matsumae, you were saying?

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: It's a win! Ayaka and the Traveler won! Oh, this exhibition match was so exciting and thrilling that I was on the edge of my seat.

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Well, you were asleep the last couple of matches with me. But this exhibition match was really good, and it even got a layman like you excited.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: That guy's passion and enthusiasm in pursuing swordsmanship is so cool! Is it too late to learn swordsmanship now...

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: It's never too late to start. As long as there is the motivation to learn, coupled with the determination to persevere, I'm sure you'll accomplish something. You might not become famous, but you could become a skilled swordsman!

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: But you're not in shape, and it's hard to pass the entrance exam for the schools of swordsmanship. Why don't you go on runs with me every day? Not only is it good exercise, you can quickly adapt when taking part in morning trainings in future!

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: ... Well, perhaps it's best that I give up on this idea.
